Messages.Author: extrala
Messages.Body:
This is taken from  Lasombra's TWDA FAQ and should help tournament organizers properly posting the tournament winning deck of an event in a new thread in the " Event Reports and TWD " category.

Please include ALL the following information in your tournament winning deck report:
name of event location of event date of event number of rounds (2R+F or 3R+F) number of players in attendance at event the correct full name of the winning player the link to the event in the calendar the entire correct contents of the deck - ARDB or VDB format strongly encouraged.
Example:
>
> Italian National Championship 2021
> Bologna, Italy
> January 8th, 2022
> 3R+F
> 23 players
> Gianluca Bianco
> https://www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10022
>
> Deck name:...
>
Optionally, you can append the number of gw/vp in the preliminary rounds and final after the event link and before the deck list using the xGWy or zvp format like this

> https://www.vekn.net/event-calendar/event/10022
>
> -- 3GW10 + 2vp in final
>
> Deck name:...
>
The subject title should be something like:
TWD - <Name of the Event>, <Location of the Event> (<Date of the Event)>)
As for the example given above the title would look like this:
>
> TWD - Italian NC 2022, Bologna (Italy) (8 Jan 2022)
>
Also, DO NOT USE THE GREEN TICK MARK AS "SYMBOL" OF YOUR POST. It is used to mark which TWD have been processed. If you put the green mark yourself, the deck will not be added to the TWD.
